register.labelZh: COME 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: come about 可以說明事情如何發生;come from 和 come of 則可以談論來源、原因和結果。；COME 片語動詞可以描述到來、返回、探訪、經過、進入、離開和追趕。；你可以用 COME 片語動詞表示偶然發現某物、突然想到構思、再次討論某個主題,或把事情提交審議。；COME 片語動詞可以描述突然出現的情緒、改變立場、主動提供協助,以及不同團體聯合起來。
register.summaryEn: Come about explains how an event happens. Come from and come of help you talk about origins, causes and results. The COME family can describe arriving, returning, visiting, passing, entering, leaving and chasing. You can use COME expressions for finding something by chance, suddenly thinking of an idea, returning to a subject or presenting a matter for a decision. COME expressions can describe a sudden emotion, changing sides, offering help and different groups uniting.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Some expressions look similar but have different meanings: come across an old photograph Come to can also express several different ideas: He came to.
